rationale: The Latin anchors certamen, pugna, and bellum all denote armed military combat, and the Vulgate citation ("Dominus docet manus meas ad prælium et digitos meos ad bellum") confirms a literal martial sense. The attestations from Beowulf, Judith, and the Battle of Brunanburh (Chr. 937) further anchor CAMP firmly to the sense of a hostile engagement between opposing military forces, matching battle.n.01 precisely.
